chunks: When you wish to bid farewell to him, say: “Peace be upon you, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. I entrust you to Allah and place you under His care. I convey peace upon you. We believe in Allah, in the Messenger, and in what she brought and indicated.”
“So write us down among those who bear witness.”

I bear witness in my death to what I bore witness to in my life. I bear witness that you are the Imams, one after another. I bear witness that those who killed you and fought you are polytheists, and whoever opposed you is in the lowest depth of Hell. I bear witness that those who fought you are enemies to us, and we are free of them, and that they are the party of Satan. O Allah, I ask You after the salat and the salutation to send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad”—and you name them, peace be upon them—“and do not make this the last of the covenant of visiting him; but if You make it so, then gather me with these named Imams. O Allah, make firm our hearts with obedience, sincere counsel, love, excellent support, and submission.”

And recite the tasbih of al-Zahra' Fatimah عليها السلام, and it is: “Glory be to the Possessor of lofty and tremendous majesty. Glory be to the Possessor of elevated, exalted, and sublime might. Glory be to the Possessor of ancient and splendid sovereignty. Glory be to the Possessor of radiance and beauty. Glory be to the One who is clothed in light and dignity. Glory be to the One who sees the trace of the ant upon the hard rock and the movement of the bird in the air.”

key_terms.أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ: I entrust you to Allah's protection and safekeeping
key_terms.التَّسْلِيمِ: complete submission and yielding in acceptance
key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةُ: the divinely designated Imams affirmed one after another
key_terms.الْجَحِيمِ: Hellfire, mentioned here as the place of severe punishment
key_terms.تَسْبِيحَ: glorification and declaration of Allah's transcendence
key_terms.مُشْرِكُونَ: those described as associating partners with Allah through their hostility

ai.seo_question: What should be recited when bidding farewell after visiting Imam Ali عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This text teaches a farewell supplication to be recited at the time of leave-taking from the ziyārah of Imam Ali عليه السلام. It combines greetings, testimony to the Imamate, disavowal from the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, supplication for steadfastness, and a concluding tasbih glorifying Allah through majestic divine attributes.
